sql:
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS num_schools
FROM 
    schools T1
INNER JOIN 
    satscores T2 ON T1.C_D_S_Cod = T2.cds2
WHERE 
    T2.Avg_Scr_Mat > 400
    AND T1.Vir = 'F';

SELECT s.C_D_S_Cod
FROM schools s
INNER JOIN frpm f ON s.C_D_S_Cod = f.C_D_S_Cod
WHERE f.Enr_K_12 > 500;

SELECT MAX(frp.Per_Eli_Fre_Age_5_17) AS HighestEligibleFreeRate
FROM frpm frp
INNER JOIN satscores ss ON frp.C_D_S_Cod = ss.cds2
WHERE (ss.Num_G_E_150 * 1.0 / ss.Num_Tst_Tak) > 0.3;
